newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Low demand,high dlr supply restrains S.Lanka rupee.
newsitem.headline: Low demand,high dlr supply restrains S.Lanka rupee.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed unchanged against the dollar on Friday due to a high supply and low demand for the U.S. unit, dealers said.
The rupee closed at its opening level of 58.92 to the dollar, they said.
"The exchange rate was steady mainly due to supply being way over demand," said a Hongkong Bank dealer.
Some dollars were even sold below the Central Bank's buying rate in the interbank market, after the Central Bank closed, dealers said.
The Central Bank pushed down the dollar by half a local cent, fixing buying and selling prices at 58.9100 and 60.1001.
Overnight call money closed at 8.75 percent after opening at 9.75, dealers said.
"Overnight call rates have also esed since many banks have sold dollars to the Central Bank these past few days," said a Sampath Bank dealer.
